candidates.prompt: Create ORIGINAL hand-painted fantasy tactical mobile game VFX production sprite sheet, effects only, genuine transparent RGBA background. Canvas portrait 1536x2048, EXACTLY THREE equal columns by FOUR equal rows; each cell 512x512, 12 isolated effects centered in their own cells with at least 60px transparent padding and no cross-cell overlap. NO labels, text, characters, hands, UI, scenery, checkerboard, ground, shadows, real-world symbols, religious symbols, pentagrams, letters or numerals. Luminous Veil navy-glass game palette, ethereal painterly luminous strokes, translucent tapered wisps, ivory glint cores, fine irregular painted edges. R1 direction: elegant delicate oval seals, slender ribbons and curved fragments, readable at 60-100px, low visual density, hollow centers. Three columns are sequential PREPARE at caster hand, TRAVEL/PEAK, IMPACT/SETTLE. ROW ONE rose-ivory Duelist MARK non-damaging: col1 tiny coiling rose thread enclosing an ivory oblong lozenge; col2 open rose-ivory circular stamp with three unequal curved petal brackets and abstract short broken strokes around empty center, no star and no explosive rays; col3 small floating rose-ivory lozenge seal, two asymmetric parenthesis wisps, quiet and compact, no damage flash. ROW TWO violet-indigo Mage SIGIL BIND: col1 small curled violet preparation knot; col2 low horizontal foreshortened oval runic circle with purely invented short dashes around rim and two chains of thin luminous linked ovals rising inward at sides, clear empty centre; col3 same LOW FOOT LEVEL ellipse closed with light chain loops pulled taut inward, tiny ivory-violet contact glint at bottom, upper half of cell mostly transparent. ROW THREE violet-indigo ARCANE STORM: col1 three tiny crystal seeds spiralling around a single ivory mote; col2 cluster of five slender falling indigo-violet arcane crystal shards with long soft tapered upward-right tails, descend diagonally down-left, gaps between shards, no broad fog; col3 ONE compact ivory-violet impact flash with low pointed crystal spray and fine dust, one impact only and no giant explosion. ROW FOUR violet-indigo DISPEL: col1 thin incomplete lilac ring gathering around empty center; col2 a hollow oval ring breaking outwards at six gaps into curved glyph-like invented segments and small angular chips, no central flash; col3 sparse outward drifting crescent fragments fading into tapered violet wisps, empty center. Effects remain distinct in silhouette. This is painted production source, no contact sheet borders. Exact regular grid placement is critical.
